name: Singapore Changi Airport

ppr.v: prior permission needed only for aircraft without radio
ppr.quote: Prior permission required for aircraft not equipped with radiotelephony.

notes: Arrival window converted from 0900-1559 UTC to Singapore time (UTC+8, no daylight saving). The AIP SUP 002/2026 (sg-sup-2026-002) gives RWY 02R/20L a full-length declared distance of 4,000 m but no width, and says that runway was closed to civil use from 19 Feb to 5 Aug 2026; the longest runway and widths were not verified. The AIP page read is valid from 09 Jul 2026 (folder 15-JUL-2026); the fetch tool only read the page up to AD 2.11.
